I think, now that i have 3,500 hours in the game its an appropriate time to write my review. 
I love this game. it is one of my favorite games ever made. i saw the launch trailer as a teen 12 years ago and was hooked by the idea of being a space ninja. 
and now i cant stop making number go bigger and change into pretty red colors. 
this game has run on a potato, worse potato (my phone and switch), and my current super computer set up. 
the shear amount of things you can do in this game is impressive. 
bored of farming? heres what you can do instead (in the video game mind you)
- explore 3 open world maps
- fish
- snowboard
- track and conserve wild life 
- play a roguelight
- drive a motor cycle
- ride a horse
- play retro like 2d side scrollers and fighter games
- play a guitar
- join or start a clan
- read and discover hundreds of thousands of pieces of lore
- play a dating sim
- fashion
- engaged in the extremely robust player market
- build optimization
- more fashion
- get pets
- pet fashion
- build optimization for pets
- Roll rivens
- hunt your own personal adversary
- use the extremely detailed photo mode
- use the robust decoration system both in your personal quarters AND your clan hall with nearly limitless possibilities.

and then... you can go back to farming. and before you know it you will have hundreds if not thousands of hours like me.

i love this game. and i will always be coming back to it. 
Thank you DE for making one of the most impactful game of my life. <3
